# Target selection (use cases covered)
## Single target
- attack a player
- attack an iron golem or other mob
- attack an animal
- if target location is unspecified, teleport workers to leader location (must get coordinates of the leader)


## Multiple targets
-  leader <leader name> workers


## Workers (warriors)
- teleport-workers teleports all workers in the session to target locatiok

combatPlan.combatRequest: Add 2 workers to hunt the nearest pig.
combatPlan.tacticalsummary: Two soldiers will coordinate to hunt a single pig.

battlefieldAssessment.recommendations: Ensure open visibility for target acquisition.

soldierInstructions.objective: Find and engage the nearest pig.
soldierInstructions.tactic: Direct frontal engagement to draw attention.

healthManagement.action: disengage immediately and move to rally point

constraints: Stay within 30 blocks of your target
Maintain at least 3 blocks distance from Soldier2
If pig escapes beyond 30 blocks, break off and regroup
Abort if not found within 60 seconds
soldierInstructions.instructionText: Equip your best sword or axe. Search for a pig within 30 blocks and engage it immediately. Attack from the front and keep a distance of 3 blocks from your partner. If the pig escapes beyond 30 blocks or your health drops below 7 hearts (14 HP), retreat instantly.

soldierInstructions.objective: Assist in engaging the nearest pig.

healthManagement.action: disengage immediately and move to rally point

constraints: Stay within 30 blocks of your target
Maintain at least 3 blocks distance from Soldier1
If pig escapes beyond 30 blocks, break off and regroup
Abort if not found within 60 seconds
soldierInstructions.instructionText: Wait 1.5 seconds then equip your best sword or axe to join the hunt. Find the pig and approach from the flank. Ensure you keep at least 3 blocks away from Soldier1. If the pig moves beyond 30 blocks or your health falls below 7 hearts (14 HP), retreat without delay.

combatPlan.victoryCondition: Successful capture or elimination of the pig.
combatPlan.failureCondition: Failure to locate pig within allotted time or if soldiers drop below retreat health threshold.
combatPlan.safetyNotes: Monitor health closely to avoid unnecessary risks.
